description: This PHP class 'RecruitmentAttachment' defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to encapsulate information related to recruitment attachments within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes properties such as id, filename, file type, size, foreign key identifier, and comments, along with corresponding constructor and getter methods.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachment
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing an attachment related to recruitment processes, encapsulating file details and related metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of RecruitmentAttachment with provided details.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: getFkIdentity
methods.description: Returns the foreign key identity associated with the attachment.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns any comment associated with the attachment.
